name: Kaishoku Rinne
source:
Long ago, an obscene ritual took place...

The town Onorochou was well known for their flourishing fishing industry. But that industry had recently started to crumble, because of a sudden steep decrease in catches.
The people of Onorochou were at a loss. What were they to do, if the low catches continued?
It was then someone from the town decided to commence an old ritual.
It was said that this ancient ritual would guarantee the town bountiful catches.

In order to do this ritual, however, a set of chosen shrine maidens had to step into the forbidden part of the town... an area which had been locked away for ages.

There, the chosen shrine maidens would have to surrender their bodies to the creatures of the sea for 7 days straight.

What fate awaited the chosen shrine maidens, Amami Kiyoka and Shigano Koko?

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/sea/story.html]official summary[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，发生了一场淫秽的仪式……

Onorochou镇以其繁荣的渔业而闻名。但由于渔获量突然急剧下降，该行业最近开始崩溃。
奥诺罗町的人们不知所措。如果渔获量持续低迷，他们该怎么办？
然后镇上的某个人决定开始一项古老的仪式。
据说，这种古老的仪式将保证小镇丰收。

然而，为了进行这个仪式，一群被选中的巫女必须踏入城镇的禁区……一个已经被封锁多年的区域。

在那里，被选中的巫女们必须连续7天将自己的身体交给海洋生物。

被选中的巫女天海清香和志贺野香子将会面临怎样的命运？

[翻译自[url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/sea/story.html]官方摘要[/url]]
